==Description==
'''Island Chaos''' was a [[Maps|map]] created by Beefchoplets that took place on a small island in the middle of the ocean.

==Design & Path==
'''Island Chaos''' was a sandy island in the middle of the ocean. There were a few wooden beach huts and some coconut trees dotted around the map. There were a few grassy mounds and a singular rock mound where you could place cliff towers on.

The brown path started and ended at two grassy caves with the path weaving around grassy mounds.

==Strategy==
*Ground towers can generally be spread out on this map due to the abundance of space.
**Generally, most ground towers should be placed near the first corner to maximize a tower's range. 
*Cliff towers, such as the [[Ranger|Outlaw]], can be placed on several mounds around the map.
*The path length is quite short, so the [[Military Base]] should not be relied upon.
